answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions only 50 entry slots, each a pearl priced by bidding. A newcomer starts on a knoll and bids a bond. The top 50 win a slot for 20 epochs, and every bid is posted on a mesa. Cheaters lose bond and slot. An attacker wanting 100 fakes must buy 100 slots: at 60 credits each that is 6,000 credits, above the 5,000-credit pool, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once, earns a steady share for 20 epochs.
